results.question: explain why harappan civilization failed using a real world example
results.author: draft-claude, team to check
results.answer: The Harappan civilization declined around 1700 BCE due to several possible reasons [S1]. These reasons include floods, external invasions, deforestation, the decline of farming, and epidemics [S1]. results.question: explain the harappan drainage system as a story
results.author: draft-claude, team to check
results.answer: The Harappan cities had a clever way to handle water waste [S1]. The water from the houses was allowed to flow into the drains [S1]. These drains were linked up with the main drain of the street [S1]. They built these drains using **burnt bricks** and covered them with stone slabs [S1]. This system worked really well even in smaller towns and villages [S1].
results.example: Imagine your neighbourhood has pipes under the road to take away rainwater, just like the Harappans did with their drains.
results.check: What materials did the Harappans use to build their drains?

results.question: I didn't understand what the Neolithic Revolution is, explain in simple words
results.author: draft-claude, team to check
results.answer:
The **Neolithic Revolution** is a big change in how people lived. It happened after the Mesolithic Age [S1]. This change was mainly about starting to **cultivate** food [S1]. People started to grow their own food instead of just gathering it [S1]. This led to a big shift in human life [S1].

- People started to settle down in river valleys [S1].
- They also began to rear animals for food [S2].
- This change is called the Neolithic Revolution [S2].
results.example: Imagine moving from just finding wild berries to planting your own garden and raising a few chickens.
results.check: What is the main difference between food gathering and food production?

- ഹരപ്പയിൽ ആദ്യത്തെ ഉൽഖനനം നടന്നത് ഈ പ്രദേശത്താണ് [S2].
- ഈ സംസ്കാരത്തെ ഹരപ്പൻ സംസ്കാരം എന്നും വിളിക്കുന്നു [S2].
